description: This file defines two data pipe classes, SamplerIterDataPipe and ShufflerIterDataPipe, used for sampling and shuffling data in data pipelines within the PyTorch data utilities. It includes class definitions, methods for data sampling, shuffling, and state management, and references external modules like torch, random, and data pipe decorators.

classes.name: SamplerIterDataPipe
classes.description: A data pipe class that generates samples from an input data pipe using a specified sampler, defaulting to SequentialSampler.

classes.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe
classes.description: A data pipe class that shuffles elements from an input data pipe using a buffer and reservoir sampling.

methods.name: SamplerIterDataPipe.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the sampler data pipe with a datapipe and sampler, setting up sampling parameters.

methods.name: SamplerIterDataPipe.__iter__
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the sampled data.

methods.name: SamplerIterDataPipe.__len__
methods.description: Returns the length of the sampler if it supports Sized.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the shuffler data pipe with a datapipe, buffer size, and unbatch level.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.set_seed
methods.description: Sets the seed for random shuffling.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.__iter__
methods.description: Yields shuffled data elements using reservoir sampling.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.__len__
methods.description: Returns the length of the underlying datapipe if it supports Sized.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer and seed for shuffling.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.__getstate__
methods.description: Returns the state for pickling, including RNG state.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.__setstate__
methods.description: Restores the state from pickling, including RNG state.
